question: In a certain code language, 'EMPIRE' is written as '5P16L18H'. How will 'EXPAND' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

'EMPIRE' is written as '5P16L18H',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c2796d8cca27832b99ac3f1b886ec28337c6515f8454185b3333405edc5e3e47.png] 

Similarly, for 'EXPAND'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e57011209be603765ea66af50f2173b8ee013afa83839af778975bf247f6e51b.png] 

So, '**EXPAND**' will be coded as '**5A16D14G**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
